source: Direct human user approval in Review des Framework-Stands; independently read through Codex read_thread after cross-chat transfer.
selected_user_instruction: Freigabe für deinen kleinsten Auftrag: neue Serienversion mit dem nativen Rechner, bis zu 6 Welten parallel mit begrenzten Bibliotheks-Threads und niedriger Priorität, volle Ströme und volles Replay, feste Abnahme, danach der Lauf. Es gelten die Auflagen A1–A5 aus Abschnitt 0.3 von Claudes „PROPOSAL_Kalibrierung_schlank.md“ (Revision 5). G1-Aufbewahrungsumbau und G2 sind zurückgestellt, G9 ist zurückgezogen. Die Wiederaufnahme der alten Scalar-Serie wird nicht weitergebaut. Während die Serie läuft, arbeite am Hauptpfad v0 weiter.

approved_source.other_sections: Retained proposal history, not blanket adoption.

scope.native_calculator: Reuse qualified exact native implementation; no float64 change
scope.library_threads: Explicit bounded limits, pinned and checked before use
scope.process_priority: Explicit low priority; preserve private-computer/v0 usability
scope.fixed_acceptance: Existing independent development/reference cases; identical serial/parallel results, intervals and digests, plus affected retry/error/resource/accounting/recovery paths. Measure full-call time/logical/physical storage during this acceptance, not a separate profiling project.

conditions.A1: A known per-world timeout does not abort the whole series. Retry that same world once under the frozen approved rule, then continue independent worlds. Determine/freeze per-world deadline under actual parallel acceptance. Retain every attempt/error/charge. Unresolved/failed after retry stays visible and cannot yield a complete calibration pass. Integrity, unknown-resource and real resource failures still stop.
conditions.A2: After approximately60 actually completed parallel worlds, project full inventory wall time using actual throughput, outstanding work/retries and overheads. Forecast above24h means controlled stop and report.
conditions.A3: Before start report logical and physical storage projections. Keep existing100GiB logical aggregate and at least20GiB freeCreserve; retain all prior charges, no budget reset. Stop/report foreseeable logical excess or reserve breach.
conditions.A4: Integration and fixed acceptance runnable within at most2 working days; otherwise present status and concrete causes, do not automatically continue building.
conditions.A5: Do not further develop or execute old Scalar optionA recovery. Preserve old series/sources/results/errors/evidence/fees; no deletion, retarget or reinterpretation.

construction_deadline.counting: Conservative end of the second counted workday: November3 and4; no later48h interpretation. This is an elapsed construction stop/report boundary, not a scientific threshold or runtime guarantee.
construction_deadline.on_miss: Stop automatic further integration/optimization and present concrete status/causes under the same work item.

resources.charge_carryover: Preserve authoritative old development/Scalar/setup accounting and explicitly bind carried prior charges before native admission; no new-version reset.

retired_scalar_state.execution_stop: Persistent existing driver stop sentinel; no Scalar run was launched. Existing records/proofs/source bytes remain intact.

deferred_or_withdrawn.G1_retention_redesign: Deferred; not part of this implementation. If limits fail, report rather than automatically implement.
deferred_or_withdrawn.other_proposal_claims: Not adopted wholesale, including any different scientific-admission or full-process-calibration claim.

during_series: Continue permitted technical main pathv0 on development2020–2023 without mutating pinned study source/results; account for desktop/v0 resources and avoid unnecessary concurrent heavy tests.
unchanged_boundaries: Full project specification, actual scientific admission/protected2024 restrictions, exact scientific criteria, exposure, freeze, separate policy/capital authority and existing inference budget remain binding. OriginalA/AgentWorkflow/AUX draft is not implicitly resumed.
rollback: Stop new dispatch at safe boundaries, retain every source/result/failure/fee and report unresolved state. Do not revive retired Scalar execution without a later explicit decision.
